limitations_and_boundaries: Model incorporated information from only two species: human and mouse. Attempts to include other species may be offset by species-specific gene expression patterns.
Current prior knowledge does not include enhancers and protein sequences; other essential information should be explored.
Only single-cell transcriptional data used; epigenomic, proteomic, and metabolomic data are not integrated.
Potential for improvement in integrating multimodal information.
The selected source chunks do not report a rescue, reconstitution, reversal, or epistasis experiment; that rung of the causal evidence chain remains untested within this extraction scope.

methods.name: GeneCompass
methods.protocol_description: A knowledge-informed cross-species foundation model based on Transformer self-attention. During pre-training, genes are ranked and combined with expression values for dual encoding input. Four types of prior biological knowledge are integrated in a self-supervised manner. Fine-tuned for downstream tasks.
